messages:
joel-sales: BankSigma POC request: Private deploy into their VPC. Must preserve client src IP for audits, allowlist a single egress IP, and tolerate their inline TLS-inspect. They attached a compliance pack. Thoughts?
mike-netops: Options: (A) VPC peering/transit -> preserves L3 src IP; needs route exchange and ASNs. (B) PrivateLink + customer egress proxy -> NAT to single IP + add signed header for original IP. (C) Dedicated connector appliance in their VPC.
ani-se: If they will accept app-layer signed header, we can avoid peering. Propose X-Orig-Client-IP + X-Orig-Client-IP-Sig (HMAC-SHA256). Our ingress verifies signature and logs result.
carmen-arch: Attestation idea: "Redwood verifies HMAC on X-Orig-Client-IP and persists headers + verification outcome to immutable audit logs for the POC window." Legal to approve.
sec-bot: Security guidance: E2E TLS preferred. If TLS inspect is used, customer must document key custody and ensure signer keys are not exposed to TLS-inspect operator. Header-signature approach acceptable if keys live in customer's KMS and rotation policy provided.
joel-sales: Pricing/customer ask: will connector/appliance be extra? They want a ballpark vs PrivateLink-only.
mike-netops: Connector = onboarding fee + monthly infra + egress billing. PrivateLink-only is cheaper but may not meet literal src IP requirement. I'll send rough numbers.
ani-se: Pasteable minimal netops checklist: create proxy host in customer VPC, allow outbound to Redwood ENIs/TCP443 (or our public IPs), configure proxy to add X-Orig-Client-IP and compute HMAC, open healthcheck port 8080 from our health CIDR, tune MTU/MSS for tunnel/SD-WAN.
joel-sales: Customer asks for cryptographic attestation in writing that we verify signature and keep logs for 90 days during POC. Can legal/security finalize?
carmen-arch: We can provide a scoped attestation pending legal approval and require customer KMS roation cadence. I'll draft wording.
joel-sales: Can we get a consolidated handoff doc (diagram + checklist + sample proxy config + cost delta) by EOD tomorrow? Customer wants to test connectivity next week.
sec-bot: Created ticket POC-1055 and assigned to eng-oncall.
